wiki.title: Mike Henderson (politician)
wiki.extract: Mike Henderson (born 1958/1959) is an American politician. He is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 3rd district, serving since 2025. He was a member of the Missouri House of Representatives from the 117th District, serving from 2017 to 2025. He is a member of the Republican party.
